highlights.en: Played on 6 days (none on Tue): 38 rounds in all, 24 quiz and 14 practice, 25 more than last week.
highlights.zh: 今個星期有 6 日玩（星期二冇玩），總共 38 局：答題 24 局、練習 14 局，比上星期多 25 局。

highlights.en: Quiz games right first time 78% (last week 75%, about the same); practice games done smoothly 73%.
highlights.zh: 答題遊戲第一次答啱 78%（上星期 75%，差唔多）；練習遊戲做得順 73%。

highlights.en: Each game had only a few rounds; we'll look at rankings next week.
highlights.zh: 每個遊戲都玩得唔多，下星期再睇排名。

highlights.en: About 35 min of games and 54 min of videos; 4 h 35 min of visa earned.
highlights.zh: 遊戲大約 35 分鐘，睇片大約 54 分鐘，賺到簽證 4 小時 35 分。

status.en: Too little play this week to rank the games.
status.zh: 今個星期玩得太少，未排名。

because.en: 3 of 6 wrong taps came before the question finished.
because.zh: 答錯嘅時候，有 3/6 次係未聽完題目就撳。

check.en: share of taps before the question finished

text.en: Try unlocking the choices only after the question has been read out (UX experiment).
text.zh: 試吓題目講完先解鎖選擇（UX 實驗）。

because.en: "Count the vehicles" often tapped before the question finished (2 of 3).
because.zh: 「數車仔」好多次未聽完題目就撳（2/3 次）。

text.en: Play a round or two together: "listen first, then tap".
text.zh: 陪佢玩一兩局，提醒佢「聽完先撳」。

praise.en: When something goes well, praise the effort: "You looked at the road so carefully!" rather than "you're clever".
praise.zh: 見到佢做得好，讚佢做嘅過程：「你好細心咁睇條路！」，唔使講「你好聰明」。

videos.en: Most-watched videos: "數字歌 1 to 10 Counting song" (21 min), "消防車出動 Fire engines on call" (19 min), "巴士總站 Bus depot tour" (15 min).
